question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'I Have the Streets - A Kutty Cricket Story'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravichandran Ashwin**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R. Ashwin **and Sidharth Monga are the authors of the book **I Have the Streets: A Kutty Cricket Story.**
 
• The book is a **co-authored autobiography that provides a detailed look at the life of a cricketer before he became famous. **
 
• **The book is a biography of the life of a cricketer** before he became famous. 
 
• It covers topics such as health issues as a child, growing up in a cricket-mad gully, and how a champion sportsman views the world. 
 
• The book also includes short profiles of the author's friends in street cricket. 
 
• **The book is published by Penguin Random House**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravichandran Ashwin is a former Indian crickete**r who played as a right-arm off-spin bowler and lower-order batsman.
 
• He was born on September 17, 1986 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• Part of the Indian team that **won the 2011 World Cup and the 2013 Champions Trophy **
 
• **One of the greatest match-winners in Test cricket history **
 
• **The highest-taking off-spin bowler in Tests **
 
• **The highest number of ten or more wicket** hauls in a Test match among Indian bowlers 
 
 
 
• **Career:** 
 
 
• Made his first-class debut for Tamil Nadu in 2006
 
• Debuted in international cricket in 2010
 
• Played for Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in the Indian Premier League (IPL)
 
• Retired from international cricket after a 15-year career
